result.text:
Done — all 14 tests pass (green before and after), in the running image.

## What changed

**1. `if`s replaced by polymorphism**

- **Products are objects now, not symbols.** New `CoffeeShopProduct` (abstract, with `=`/`hash` by kind) and subclasses `Combo1` (150 pesos, 250 ml) and `Combo2` (120 pesos, 100 ml), each answering `price` and `volume`. This killed `CoffeeShopSalesSystem>>volumeOf:` (three-way `if` on `#Combo1`/`#Combo2`) — `volumeSoldTo:` now just sums `aProduct volume` — and `RewardRule>>priceOf:` (the same `if` chain for prices).
- **Customer types are objects now, not symbols.** New `CoffeeShopCustomerType` with `GoldCustomerType`, `SilverCustomerType`, `NormalCustomerType`, each knowing `combo1RewardPrice` (75/83/97 pesos) and `combo2RewardPrice` (1/2, 3/4, 9/10 of the Combo 2 price). This killed the two `aCustomer type = #Gold ifTrue: [...]` chains in `Combo1RewardRule>>createRewardFor:` and `Combo2RewardRule>>createRewardFor:`.
- **`createRewardFor:` was pulled up** into `RewardRule` (it was duplicated in both subclasses, differing only in the price); each subclass now implements only `priceFor:`, `rewardedProduct` and `productQuantity`. The now-unused `product` instance variable of `RewardRule` is gone.
- `CoffeeShopReward>>isForCombo1`/`isForCombo2` (hidden type tests) were removed in favour of a `product` accessor, so tests assert `self assert: self combo2 equals: reward product`.

**2. Duplication in tests 2 and 3** — extracted `assertOnly:wasSoldTo:`, used once in test02 and twice in test03.

**3. Duplication in the last 6 tests** — extracted `assertRewardFor:buying:is:of:at:` (plus `registerSalesTo:of:`), and the two purchase scenarios as `purchasesRewardedWithCombo2` (350 ml) and `purchasesRewardedWithCombo1` (600 ml). Each of tests 09–14 is now a single message send. The `salesSystem := CoffeeShopSalesSystem new` repeated in all 14 tests moved to `setUp`.

The test class moved to the system category `IngSof1-2019-2C-1Parcial-Tests`; the model classes stay in `IngSof1-2019-2C-1Parcial`. All new classes got comments.

One thing I did **not** do: the `IngSof1` package has unsaved changes but no file name recorded, so it cannot be written out until one is set. Tell me a path if you want it filed out (and whether to save the image).
